text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden. I have 6 years of experience in machine learning and NLP, and I’m comfortable working in fast-paced, communication-heavy tasks that require consistency, professionalism, and attention to detail.

I’m interested in your Real Estate Cold Caller/VA role and can help gauge prospect interest, handle objections calmly, and enter lead information accurately into your webform. I’m customer-service oriented, can work in a competitive environment, and understand the importance of clear English communication. I can also adapt quickly to your dialer workflow and follow your process closely.

I have a stable work setup and am ready to support your team with reliable daily outreach. I’d be happy to provide a resume and voice recording sample as requested.
